mapper.select: SELECT id, board_id AS boardId, nickname, content, ip_address AS ipAddress, created_at AS createdAt FROM comments WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (board_id, nickname, password, content, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{dto.nickname}, #{dto.password}, #{dto.content}, #{dto.ipAddress}, SYSDATETIME())
